$schema_note: Curated inpatient unit roster. Compiled 2026-08-10 from the HUP wayfinding directory, nursing.upenn.edu Guide to Units (stale, pre-2021), Penn Nursing NURS 2450 clinical placements (Coursicle), careers.pennmedicine.org job postings (highest-yield source for current unit identity + bed counts), med.upenn.edu program pages, and pennmedicine.org. Unit-to-service assignments churn; every entry carries confidence + era + source. Room generation: 'ranges' = HUP Main wayfinding room numbers; 'pavilion_wing' = floor x wing under the published 1-72 City/Center/Campus numbering; 'count' = bed-count-only units. Pavilion floor 13 is deliberately NOT modeled: 504 licensed rooms = exactly 7 floors x 72 slots (7,8,9,10,11,12,14) and no source names any floor-13 unit. EP-8 adds per-unit 'capabilities' (telemetry: all|none across the unit's rooms; negative_pressure_first_n: that many airborne-isolation rooms, seeded deterministically onto the FIRST rooms in generation order - no RNG) and 'staffing' (target_rn_ratio = patients per RN). Both are inferred defaults from professional staffing/design norms, NOT sourced to HUP - each carries confidence + note; correct per-unit as verified. Service-line membership lives in service_lines.json (total mapping, compiler-enforced). EP-23 (2026-08-13): owner ruled all 11 formerly-unsourced units after a targeted OSINT session (per-unit sources/notes below; framework in roadmap/EP-23-service-line-rulings.md). Six units retired to assets/data/archive/ep23_roster_rulings.json (42-unit roster): Founders 5 + Founders 9 (SICU ruled Rhoads 5, MICU ruled Founders 8), Rhoads 2 + Rhoads 10 (no corroborated service; Rhoads 10 = directory artifact), Pavilion 8 Campus + 14 City (no evidence of distinct inpatient units). 'pavilion_wing' specs may carry 'slots' (range syntax) to model partial/spanning wings - floor 12 splits Center between the 12-bed Oncology MICU (13-24) and the 36-bed 12 Campus (25-60).
